title: Super Supportive · Episode 26 · 不是给你吃的
description: An unplanned midnight visit, a furious cat, and a very unusual slumber party. Feltboard × American comics × Art Nouveau.

planning.storytellingVoice: Warm, self-questioning adolescent: source-supported self-mockery and a lonely admission, then playful talk with Gorgon.
planning.desire: Find company because he cannot sleep.
planning.obstacle: Closed consulate and Gorgon’s initial refusal.
planning.earlyCare: He brings food and offers to help with chores.
planning.payoff: Gorgon lets him in and Victor is released; they can spend the evening together.
planning.continuingQuestion: What will their strange late-night visit become?
planning.direction: Hold Alden outside after admitting nobody will miss him; Gorgon’s pause and sigh change the relationship. Use cartoon timing for cat misunderstanding without mocking loneliness.

artDirection.repeatPolicy: Exclude previous crayon; downweight recent charcoal/watercolour/ink and shonen/paper-cut influence. Prior pre-25 panel styles are not separately recorded.
artDirection.texture: Fuzzy layered wool felt, stitched details, soft physical cast shadows; Art Nouveau curves
artDirection.identity: Alden: brown tousled hair, charcoal hoodie and gray shirt; Gorgon: gray alien, four nasal slits, black eyes, swept head spikes, golden bindings; Victor: scarred orange tomcat

continuation.end: Near eleven Alden brings groceries, a pillow and angry Victor to the closed consulate. His lonely admission persuades Gorgon to admit him, shoes off. Gorgon’s glance at Victor prompts Alden to insist the cat is a guest, not food. Victor is released; Gorgon explains his bindings’ tripping hazard. Alden proposes riding the elevator and snacking; no tour or injury yet.
continuation.nextEndBefore: He cupped his other hand beneath the bitten one
continuation.note: Tour, windows, chips and salsa, tuna peace offering, Victor’s attack and Gorgon’s first laughter. Stop before Alden heads to wash his hand and has the blood idea.
